text: I would say number 15 is the most different out of all of these. The wick for the candle is a lot bigger than all the other ones going past half the block. This also has about four or five from the mistake in dots on the blue side, which is one of the lowest ones. It's about, I don't know what I'm saying, about number three or number four out of the number of dots. The line or the divider looks about the same. Everything else about it is quite a bit bigger. On the red side, these dots are the only ones that are grouped up to this as close to the wick. Everyone else has a dot or two sparing out for the ones that don't. They even go past the middle of the block. This is also the smallest candle out of all of them. If I'm not mistaken, the only one except for number 20 that has it as close to the left wall as possible.
